page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-60-lssd is a general-purpose server powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 60 dedicated virtual CPUs, which correspond to 30 physical cores with multithreading enabled, and 240 GB of RAM. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The hardware setup includes 1608 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across four local drives, and it does not include a GPU.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core and Passmark CPU scores placing in the top 25% of tested servers. The server demonstrates high memory bandwidth for small, cached blocks at 4247.26 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read and write speeds perform at average levels of 146.58 GB/sec and 52.61 GB/sec respectively. Cryptographic and vector execution capabilities are supported by AVX-512 and AES instruction sets, yielding strong results in Passmark encryption and software compilation tests.

This server configuration is suited for database operations, software compilation, and medium-scale language model inference. It achieves 78.94 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and strong Passmark database scores. The qualitative cost efficiency is driven by the high density of dedicated AMD EPYC cores paired with bundled high-speed local NVMe storage, reducing the need for external storage attachments for I/O-heavy workloads.

It is best suited for database hosting, software development pipelines, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
